title: Intake Air Pressure Sensor #1
shortDescription: Main IAP sensor out of range.
fullDescription:
Kawasaki DFI service code 11 indicates primary intake air pressure sensor failure. Engine may run rich and exhibit poor throttle response.

Often found on Ninja 300/400/650/ZX-6R. Common after fairing work that disturbed the sensor hose.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect hose
fixSteps.instruction: Secure IAP vacuum hose with zip tie.

videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 11 IAP fix

faq.a: Disconnect battery 2 min or use KDS dealer tool.

title: Intake Air Temp Sensor
fullDescription:
Code 12 indicates intake air temperature sensor circuit open or shorted. ECU defaults to 20C.

Mostly cosmetic effect on performance; still replace for emissions.

fixSteps.title: Replace IAT
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, unscrew from airbox, install new.

videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 12 IAT fix

faq.a: No — FI light on inspection fail.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor
fullDescription:
Code 13 on Kawasaki DFI indicates coolant temp sensor failure. Fan operation and cold-start fueling affected.

On Ninja and Versys models sensor mounts on thermostat housing.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 13 ECT fix

title: Throttle Position Sensor
fullDescription:
Code 14 indicates TPS fault. Ride-by-wire ZX models enter limp mode.

Cable-driven models only set the code and may still run normally.

fixSteps.title: Replace TB
fixSteps.instruction: On KZ-T throttle body is a unit; replace complete.

videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 14 TPS fix

title: Crankshaft Sensor
shortDescription: No or erratic crank sensor signal.
fullDescription:
Code 21 indicates crankshaft position sensor fault. Engine may fail to start.

Check sensor tip for debris or damaged teeth.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 21 crank sensor fix

title: Cam Position Sensor
fullDescription:
Code 23 indicates the camshaft sensor is not signaling to identify cylinder position.

Engine may run but lack sequential injection benefits.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove valve cover area shroud, swap sensor.

videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 23 cam sensor fix

title: Speed Sensor
fullDescription:
Code 24 is VSS fault; speedo reads zero. Cruise, traction control, and KTRC disable on equipped models.

Sensor mounts at front sprocket on sport bikes.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 24 speed sensor fix

title: Bank Angle Sensor
shortDescription: Lean angle sensor fault or tripped.
fullDescription: Code 31 on Kawasaki covers bank angle sensor. Cycling key resets after drop; persistent code means sensor fault.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 31 bank angle fix

title: O2 Sensor Heater
fullDescription:
Code 33 reports O2 heater open. Sensor warm-up delayed causing initial rich fueling.

Replace as sensor assembly.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 33 O2 heater fix

title: Fuel Injector Fault
fullDescription:
Code 41 flags injector fault on one or more cylinders. Bike will miss and smell of fuel.

Check harness and resistance.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 41 injector fix

title: Ignition Coil Fault
fullDescription:
Code 46 indicates coil primary out of range. Bike misfires on affected cylinder.

Replace coil or stick coil depending on model.

fixSteps.title: Swap coils
fixSteps.instruction: Move suspect coil to known good cylinder.

videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 46 coil fix

title: Fuel Pump Relay Fault
fullDescription:
Code 56 indicates ECU cannot command fuel pump relay. No pump prime at key-on; bike will not start.

Check relay, fuse, and pump wiring.

fixSteps.title: Swap relay
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with known-good relay of same type.

fixSteps.title: Test pump
fixSteps.instruction: Apply 12V directly to confirm pump runs.

whenToCallPro: If pump itself needs replacing in-tank.
videoSearchQuery: Kawasaki motorcycle service code 56 fuel pump relay fix

faq.a: Listen for 2-second hum at key on.
